name: FormLabAI by MM Gurgaon (In-Person Session) | NOV 1

location.name: DRIVE FITT Gurgaon
location.address: DRIVE FITT Gurgaon, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

description:
ABOUT THIS EVENT

Make this your day one of understanding your running form. Main Mission is coming to Gurgaon for the first time, and we're bringing FormLabAI to help you get to know how you run. Come get curious about your form and find a starting point for what to work on.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Join us at DRIVE FITT for a 3-minute treadmill run. FormLabAI analyses video of your cadence, stride and knee angles, then gives you a form score and a starting point for what to work on first. The event runs from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM, with only 15 slots available.

A few guidelines for the day:

- Footwear: bring an extra pair of footwear to wear inside the gym so the gym stays clean. You can come in your slippers and change. You'll also need running shoes for the treadmill.

- Attire: come in shorts or slightly tighter lowers. Very loose pants don't work with the pose model, so this keeps your analysis accurate.

WHO IS THIS FOR

Runners who have completed a 5K and want to work on their form. Form is an important metric, but showing up and completing a 5K comes first. If you haven't done your 5K yet, sit this one out, go finish it, and join us at the next session.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

- A 3-minute treadmill run for your assessment

- AI-powered video analysis of your cadence, stride and knee angles

- Your running-form score

- A starting point for what to work on first
